watches.name: Banaue Rice Terraces
watches.description: Time is a canvas; wear your story. Discover the breathtaking beauty of the Banaue Rice Terraces, a UNESCO World Heritage site, with our exclusive custom-painted watch - a true testament to artistry and heritage. This exquisite timepiece is meticulously handcrafted, showcasing a stunning depiction of the iconic rice terraces, famous for their lush greenery and intricate patterns carved into the mountainsides by the Ifugao people. Embrace the harmony of artistry and craftsmanship with the Banaue Rice Terraces Custom Painted Watch – celebrate the beauty of the Philippines and make a statement that transcends time. watches.name: Villamor
watches.description: Be the hero you want to be. December 12, 1942 -- A fleet of state-of-the-art Japanese "Zero" fighter planes fly within the Pacific Ocean theatre of war. The Filipino-American air force led by fighter pilot Jesus Villamor, in true David versus Goliath fashion, courageously engage the superior enemy fleet with their outclassed P-26 "Peashooters". Their success in this encounter ultimately earned Villamor a Distinguished Service Cross (DSC) from the American army, immortalising himself in the annals of Philippine history. KLO & CO celebrates this patriotic act of courage and service against all odds through the Villamor wristwatch.
